text.p: McGraw-Hill Cos said Monday it is restructuring its Global Division into three regions, creating a new tier of strategists to accelerate the company's international expansion.
The company said the first of three regional chiefs, Luis A. Viada, was named managing director for Latin America.

The three regional managing directors -- for Latin America, Asia and Europe -- will report to Jeff Williams, who joined McGraw-Hill in September as executive vice president of global markets and strategic development.

McGraw-Hill said Asia and Latin America have been targeted because of their burgeoning markets and rapidly developing economies. Like Europe before them, the Asian and Latin American regions have seen the recent emergence of a substantial middle class and are attracting corporate investors from inside and outside their borders.
Viada previously was managing director and region head for Latin America for the Standard & Poor's Ratings Services operation of McGraw-Hill.
